title: HONG BAO GROUP (lovelywines.co.th) — claimed by incransom
description:
TH · Retail & E-Commerce · # HONG BAO GROUP — DATA BREACH

**Hong Bao Group** (หงเปา กรุ๊ป) — a major Thai restaurant conglomerate operating 15+ restaurant brands across Bangkok, including **Hong Bao Restaurant**, **Water Library**, **Lovely Wine**, **PLU (พลู)**, **CIAO PIZZA**, **Bistro**, and **SEED** — has suffered a complete network compromise resulting in the exfiltration of their entire corporate infrastructure.
